product.title: Marco Island Dolphin Sightseeing Tour

description.text: Look for dolphins in the waters of the Ten Thousand Islands on this boat tour from Marco Island. With a captain-guide, explore a piece of Florida's gulf coast to see and learn about the natural environment. Equipment, safety briefings, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on dolphins, shelling beaches, and Everglades wildlife. Ideal for Naples and Marco Island visitors who want shallow-water shelling, dolphin watching, and mangrove-lined routes without chartering a boat alone.
